classifications.explicit_policy: Explicit source/maintainer/corpus contract; not inferred product intent.
classifications.explicit_mechanism: Source establishes the mechanism; no broader product rationale is invented.
classifications.implementation_constraint: Platform/API/current-transport condition, not universal OS impossibility.
classifications.observed_limit: Verified boundary without an established stronger promise.

differences.title: Restorable clipboard formats

behavior.linux: Text-only wl-clipboard/xclip/xsel restoration; URI MIME availability differs

differences.rationale: Native transport/API contracts; losing borrowed formats is a follow-up, not a settled policy to discard them.

differences.title: How selected text is acquired

behavior.windows: Sequence-owned Ctrl+C capture/UIA or native editor paths
behavior.macos: AX/native or temporary Cmd+C borrowing depending action
behavior.linux: PRIMARY for selected open/search; temporary clipboard for legacy transform; retained AT-SPI for LLM

differences.rationale: Actual owners differ by action, not just OS. No claim that all paths share the strongest destination guard.

differences.title: Final copy versus temporary borrowing

behavior.linux: Same final-output semantics with native tools

differences.rationale: Borrowed selection/paste data must be distinguished from intentional final-copy output. This policy does not authorize stale borrower restoration.

differences.title: Case transformation equivalence

behavior.windows: OS simple case mapping excludes certain expanding/contextual corpus vectors

differences.rationale: Same case-action presence does not guarantee identical Unicode output; shared corpus names driver-specific exclusions.

differences.title: Typed-symbol selection wrapping

behavior.macos: Explicit shortcut wrapping is available; do not infer typed-symbol parity from wrap_selection
behavior.linux: PRIMARY-based wrap-on-type avoids Ctrl+C in terminals

differences.rationale: Manifest platform reasons and actual entry behavior distinguish typed character interception from explicit wrapping action.

differences.title: Copy completion strength

behavior.macos: Native changeCount available; not all borrowers consult it

differences.rationale: Missing session/tool confirmation remains tracked; tool presence is not proof of compositor support.

differences.title: API credential storage and transfer
differences.rationale: Native unlock, account identity and backup transferability differ; no general configuration-backup promise reconstructs every native secret.

differences.title: Existing credential exceptions

behavior.windows: Retired provider rows deliberately preserved; active entries sealed
behavior.macos: Standard HF SDK token file/optional git store and clear proxy preferences have separate ownership
behavior.linux: Legacy clear rows can remain until Secret Service migration; proxy preferences deliberately clear

differences.rationale: These scope exceptions are documented; they do not excuse newly added plaintext fallbacks or secret bytes in native argv.

differences.title: Metrics cipher key source

behavior.linux: Machine-id-derived local material with native support requirements

differences.rationale: Machine-derived selective protection, not a password/export/key-vault feature or isolation from same-user code. Knowing or copying the derivation identity permits off-device derivation too; this layer alone must not be described as protecting a full-disk image containing that identity. Identity loss/restore has limits.

differences.title: Cipher confidentiality versus authentication

behavior.macos: Shared AES-CBC envelope; bundled Encryptor CBC is separate

differences.rationale: No MAC/AEAD integrity promise found. Controlled tamper acceptance is documented as a limitation, not invented as a violated authentication contract.

differences.title: Bundled file Encryptor

behavior.macos: macOS-only app with approved overwrite prompt

differences.rationale: This app is separate from shared metrics/text cipher protection. Missing counterparts already belong to the previous parity TODO; do not count them anew.

differences.title: Unsupported/unknown configuration data

behavior.windows: ADR009 preservation and read-only future/invalid schema
behavior.macos: Shared Lua schema policy; preserves outdated keys until explicit cleanup
behavior.linux: Same shared policy; separate historical storage import

differences.rationale: Unknown retained data is not an absent cleanup feature. Explicit cleanup and ordinary saves have different permissions.

differences.title: Configuration formatting ownership

behavior.windows: Full-model save can canonicalize comments/format; no-op/targeted paths differ
behavior.linux: Untouched document records preserved; neutral leaves sparse

differences.rationale: Do not promise byte preservation for every Windows full save, or treat valid sparse neutral leaves as a bug. Stale import authority is a separate defect.

differences.title: Movable config and native bootstrap

behavior.windows: Early paths.toml locator and Registry/native storage
behavior.macos: Managed/development locator and namespaced native settings
behavior.linux: XDG config plus private bootstrap storage.json

differences.rationale: Moving/syncing the selected configuration folder does not move all native settings, data or secret-service items.

differences.title: Saved intent and rejected publication

behavior.windows: Canonical locale save can be accepted with explicit reload-refused result
behavior.macos: Folder locator may remain saved after reload refusal; rejected locale must be distinguished
behavior.linux: Some live-apply owners retain accepted saved intent; rejected locale is separately inconsistent

differences.rationale: A loud, truthful saved-but-unapplied receipt is not a rollback bug. MCF001/LCF002 concern explicitly rejected choices.

differences.title: File writer lease strength

behavior.macos: Advisory cooperating writer lease plus exact byte checks
behavior.linux: Shared file lease/byte admission and native atomic publication constraints

differences.rationale: No generic kernel cross-process CAS or crash/power-loss guarantee is inferred merely from a successful ordinary writer test.

differences.title: Native desktop system semantics

behavior.windows: Endpoint mute, Explorer/WM_CLOSE and Windows theme state

differences.rationale: Equivalent user intent does not make native command/result contracts identical. All three fixed-action reports document the exact variants.

differences.title: Asynchronous work and error observation

behavior.windows: Deferred script callbacks; some native workers start without completion tracking
behavior.macos: Owned async tasks with bounded cleanup/degraded debt, fenced callbacks
behavior.linux: Background shell keeps grabbed-keyboard loop responsive

differences.rationale: Asynchronous dispatch is intentional. Losing an available refusal/error channel is a separate follow-up, not a consequence that must be accepted.
